t: The Goldscrew mixed TX woodscrews trade pack offers a comprehensive selection of high-quality, multipurpose woodscrews for reliable fastening in timber applications. Ideal for professional joiners, carpenters, and general builders undertaking diverse indoor projects, from bespoke furniture assembly to secure floorboard installations. Each carbon steel woodscrew features a durable zinc-plated, wax-coated finish, ensuring lower screw-in torque and faster drive speed. The double-countersunk head provides a smooth, flush finish. This 1400-piece assortment, including fully and partially threaded lengths, delivers robust and long-lasting performance.
